subject: environmental-science
title: The Chapman Cycle
welcome_lead: Stratospheric ozone is constantly created and destroyed — meet Sydney Chapman's elegant scheme.
meta_desc: A-Level Environmental Science adventure on the Chapman cycle and ozone formation.
final_note: Without Chapman's cycle, life on land would be impossible — UV would shred biomolecules.

walkthroughs.body_html: UV-C splits O₂ into atomic O, which combines with O₂ to form O₃ (M = third body).
UV-B splits O₃ → O₂ + O, releasing heat that warms the stratosphere — the basis of the temperature inversion.
Chapman's reactions reach a steady-state column ~300 DU at mid-latitudes. Halogen radicals shift the balance.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between ozone depletion and climate change?
options: Two distinct issues - ozone depletion is about UV protection (caused mainly by CFCs); climate change is about heat trapping (caused mainly by CO2).
They are the same problem.
Decomposition.
Ozone depletion causes climate change directly.

mcqs.q: What process moves carbon from the atmosphere into plants?
options: Decomposition.
Photosynthesis.
Respiration.
Ozone depletion causes climate change directly.

mcqs.q: Why is burning fossil fuels considered to disrupt the carbon cycle?
options: It releases carbon stored for millions of years much faster than the cycle can absorb.
Ozone depletion causes climate change directly.
It removes carbon permanently.
It creates new carbon that did not exist before.
